pages.title: The Reach of a Strike
pages.text: A hippogryph talon keeps its sharpness after death. Bound into this charm, that force reaches beyond the claw tips, giving a dragon's forward claw sweep greater reach in human form.

pages.title: Breaking the Line
pages.text: Melee damage increases by 15%% in either form. In human form, ordinary claw attacks have 20%% more reach and a wider forward sweep. Tail sweeps and the dragon form's native attack range are unchanged. It cannot be worn with the Wild Pendant or Hunter King Pendant.
